title: Device Register - request  (firmware -> POST /api/Device/Register)
description: Body built by AgrumyFirmware DeviceController::registerDevice() (payload[...] lines). This is the unauthenticated bootstrap call - identity is proven by email + devicePin in the body, NOT by headers. Server model: api.Models.DeviceRegistration.
$comment: properties = every key the server binds (generated from DeviceRegistration); required = what the firmware always sends. Firmware does NOT send 'servicePoint' (it only uses it as the URL host, the server defaults it to "api.agrumy.com"), nor the isGateway/gatewayProfile/gatewayRegistrationSecret trio, which only Agrumy.Gateway's own registration sends.

macAddress.description: Uppercase hex with no separators, from WiFi.macAddress() (e.g. "240AC4040AF8"). Binds to DeviceRegistration.MacAddress; the server also builds DeviceName as "Agrumy_" + macAddress.ToUpper().

email.description: User account e-mail (firmware sends config["userLogin"]). Binds to DeviceRegistration.Email; the server looks the user up by it and checks the PIN.

devicePin.description: The user's device PIN. Firmware sends it as a STRING (char devicePin[8], so at most 7 chars); since roadmap #70 the server generates a 6-char uppercase alphanumeric code (no O/I/0/1), compares case-insensitively, and expires it after 24h - it is reusable for multiple registrations in that window, not consumed by the first one. The server property is string? (DeviceRegistration.DevicePin).

servicePoint.description: Not sent by firmware - server default "api.agrumy.com" applies when absent.

serviceType.description: Echoed from DeviceDefaults.serviceType (0 http, 1 https, 2 mqtt - ServiceTypeIds / DeviceServiceTypeIds). Binds to DeviceRegistration.ServiceType; the server stores but does not currently act on it.

displayName.description: Operator-facing label typed on the captive portal, "" when none - only used as DeviceName when the device has no Discovery-provisioned name queued; the AP SSID stays Agrumy_<mac> regardless.

isGateway.description: Agrumy.Gateway only; firmware never sends it. Honored only together with a matching gatewayRegistrationSecret, silently dropped otherwise.

gatewayRegistrationSecret.description: Agrumy.Gateway only - must equal the server's Gateway:RegistrationSecret for isGateway to be honored.
